langSub: You can change this anytime in Settings.
welcomeSub: A calm home for your tasks. First — what should we call you?
lookSub: Pick a color and a mode. You can change these anytime in Settings.
purposeSub: Pick a few and we’ll set up matching folders. Skip if you’d rather start blank.
captureSub: Just type — kiln reads dates, times, priority and folders right out of your words.
yourTurn: Your turn — add your first task
firstTaskHint: We’ll drop it on your Today list so you land somewhere alive.
completeSub: Tap the circle to complete a task — or drag it to the bottom of the screen to finish with a flourish.
accountSub: Create a free account to save your tasks and sync them across every device — or just start now on this one.
tourDone: That’s the tour. Back to your tasks.
installTitle: Put kiln on your home screen
installSub: Opens full-screen like an app and updates itself.
iosSteps: In Safari, tap Share {icon}, then “Add to Home Screen”.
otherSteps: Open your browser menu ⋮ and choose “Add to Home screen” or “Install app”.
backupNotJson: That file isn’t a kiln backup (not valid JSON).
backupNotKiln: That file doesn’t look like a kiln backup.
backupNoFolders: That backup has no folders in it.
syncOffline: Offline — changes are saved on this device and will sync when you’re back
syncError: Can’t reach the server right now — changes are saved on this device, retrying
notifBlocked: Notifications are blocked — allow them for kiln in settings
testOnWay: Test on its way: lock your phone
notifBlockedIos: Notifications are blocked — allow them for kiln in iPhone Settings
deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete right now — please try again
displayNameHint: Used in your greeting on the Today screen.
textSizeSub: Drag to make every label easier to read
reducedVisualsSub: Turns off blur, glow & confetti — lighter on older phones
remindersHint: An alert at each task’s time (tasks with a time, like “call mum 5pm”), and at 9 am on days with tasks due.
ambientHint: A calm full-screen clock + today view for a second monitor or a docked phone. Every part of it — clock size, dial, layout, widgets, Ember, night mode — is tweakable with a live preview.
sendFeedback: Send feedback or report a bug
restoreConfirm: Replace your current tasks with this backup ({folders}, {tasks})? What you have now moves to the Trash.
signOutStuck: Some changes haven’t reached the cloud yet (you may be offline). Signing out now removes them from this device.
deleteConfirmCloud: This permanently erases your account and all synced data. It can’t be undone.
deleteConfirmLocal: This permanently erases your account and everything on this device. It can’t be undone.
exportFirst: Prefer to keep a copy? Export your data first.
archiveEmpty: Nothing archived. Archive a task to tuck it away without deleting it.
trashEmpty: Trash is empty. Deleted tasks land here and are erased after 30 days.
trashHead: Deleted tasks are erased 30 days after removal.
tipSwipe: Swipe right across the screen to open your folders.
tipPull: Pull down on the title to search or jump anywhere.
empty_search_body: Nothing fits that search. Try different words.
empty_today_body: Nothing due today. Enjoy it — or add something in the bar above.
empty_upcoming_body: No scheduled tasks ahead. Add a due date to a task to see it here.
empty_all_body: No tasks yet. Write your first one in the bar above.
empty_project_body: This folder is empty. Add its first task in the bar above.
errEmailInvalid: That doesn’t look like an email address.
checkInboxNewEmail: Check your inbox to confirm the new email
errReauth: For safety, sign out and back in, then change your password.
newEmailHint: We’ll send a confirmation link. Your email changes once you tap it.
errResetExpired: This reset link expired — request a new one from the sign-in screen.
newPasswordSub: choose a new password for your {app} account
linkFailedSub: it was used already or has expired. Sign in, and if your email still needs verifying we’ll send a fresh code.
verifiedSubIn: welcome to {app} — your account is ready
verifiedSubOut: your account is ready — sign in to continue
errBadCredentials: That email and password don’t match an account.
errUserExists: There’s already an account with this email. Sign in instead.
errEnterCode: Enter the code from the email.
errCodeBad: That code didn’t work. Use the code from the newest kiln email, or send a new one.
errCodeRecent: A code went out moments ago. Check your inbox, or send another when the timer ends.
errRateLimit: Too many emails to this address. Use the newest code, or try again in a while.
newCodeSent: New code sent. Use the newest email
codeSentHint: Type the 6 digits here to finish signing up.
resendCode: Didn’t get it? Send a new code
resetSentTo: We sent a password reset link to
resetSentHint: Click it to choose a new password.
guestNote: Guest data stays on this device only.
subArchive: tucked away, out of your way
storageFull: This device’s storage is full — recent changes may not survive a reload
quickAddPh: Add a task…  try “pay rent friday 5pm”
folderDeletedTasks_one: Folder deleted — {n} task moved to Trash
folderDeletedTasks_other: Folder deleted — {n} tasks moved to Trash
name: Name
deleteFolderConfirm: Delete folder? Tasks go to Trash
seedTask1: Tap the circle to complete me — watch what happens ✨
seedTask2: Drag the ⋮⋮ grip to reorder me
seedTask3: Tap me to edit notes, dates, time & priority
seedTask3Notes: Everything is editable inline. Try moving me to another folder.
seedTask4: Add a task using the bar above
seedTask5: Explore Calendar, Focus & the ⚙ Settings menu
seedTask6: Finish every task in a folder for a surprise 🎉
remindersOnNudge: Reminders on — you’ll get a nudge when tasks are due
remindOffer: Want a ping when it’s due? Turn on reminders.
notifAllowThenBack: Allow notifications for kiln, then come back — reminders switch on by themselves.
signOutFromSettings: Some changes haven’t synced yet — sign out from Settings
paletteSearchPh: Search tasks, run a command, or add a task…
tipCalendar: Any task with a due date shows up here. Tap a day to see it, and add tasks straight onto it.
habitAdded: Habit added — check it off daily
tipInsights: Add daily habits to build streaks, and watch your week come together in the charts below. Completed tasks and focus sessions feed these numbers automatically.
habitsEmpty: Track a daily habit and build a streak. Add one above to start.
gBackDo: Closes what’s open, then opens your folders
sayFolder: Folder (made for you if it’s new)
typeLikeSay: Type it like you’d say it, e.g.
fbWhatHappened: What happened, and what did you expect?
fbDeviceSub: App version, browser and screen size. Helps us find bugs faster.
fbOpensMail: Opens your mail app. No mail app? Write to
tipFocus: Pick 25·5, 50·10, or a custom length. Every finished session counts toward your Insights.
resetConfirm: Reset kiln on this device? A backup file of your local data downloads first.
ember_focus_0: Heads down — back in a bit.
ember_worried_2: Might want to glance at the list.
ember_sleepy_0: Nothing due. Rest or plan tomorrow.
digestBody_one: {n} task due today — go shape something.
digestBody_other: {n} tasks due today — go shape something.
testReminderBody: Reminders work. You’ll hear from kiln when tasks are due.
ambAddedFor: Added for {date} — not on today’s board
ambHint: Dates, times, !high and #folder are read from your words
ambQuickAddPh: Add a task…  try “call mom 26 oct 6pm !high”
newVersion: A new version of kiln is ready
cl_20261025_title: Easier to read, easier to swipe
cl_20261025_0: Text size: drag the new slider in Settings → Appearance to make everything bigger.
cl_20261025_1: Small labels are larger by default.
cl_20261025_2: On Android, swipe right from anywhere in the middle of the screen to open your folders. No more accidentally closing kiln.
cl_20261025_3: New: Help, Send feedback, and change your email or password in Settings.
cl_20261024_0: Sign up with a 6-digit code from your email.
cl_20261024_1: Quick add understands real dates like “26 oct” and “12/11”.
cl_20261024_2: Sync is safer: changes made on two devices at once no longer overwrite each other.
cl_20261024_3: Install kiln to your home screen. It now updates itself when you open it.
ame_a_widget_with_nothing_to_show_no_foc: A widget with nothing to show (no focus running, no streak yet) stays hidden.
ame_nudges_everything_by_up_to_this_many: Nudges everything by up to this many pixels every 3 minutes. 0 turns it off.
